integrity: Proof and recurrence are self-contained; the auxiliary checker uses only Python standard library. No independent validation or empirical calibration is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply to Poisson infinite-population mean-field stationary distributions; no finite-population limit or global convergence assertion. The mean-one standard discrete Gini comparison uses the equal-mean geometric benchmark. The fixed-arrival queue law is classical; novelty is limited to its self-consistent economic specialization and inequality implication.
title: Exact stationary wealth law and an inequality reversal for compulsory unit transfers
